summary: Creates a new node in a singly-linked node list anchored at this+0x13C, sizes its element/data-block array from the count at this+0x130, copies 136-byte source blocks from this+0x134, resolves each block's name against a parameter table (a2) so matched blocks store the table entry value and unmatched blocks store -1, stores the parameter table pointer on the node, and runs the sub-init chain via EntityFlagSetSubInitChain. On a null data-block count a single-element node is produced instead.

local_names.blockCount: number of data blocks to copy, read from this+0x130
local_names.srcBlocks: source data-block array, read from this+0x134
local_names.listHead: head/tail of the existing node list, this+0x13C
local_names.paramTable: parameter table a2: count at +12, entries at +16, entry stride 44

operations.description: Gates on the data-block count at this+0x130: a non-zero count takes the multi-block copy path, a zero count takes the single-element node path.
Walks the existing node list anchored at this+0x13C, following next pointers at +0x24 (including the chains expressed via this+0x160), to reach the tail before appending the new node.
Allocates a 40-byte node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(40); a null result leaves the node pointer null.
Initializes the fresh node with sub_5510F0(node, blockCount) so its element array is sized for the data-block count (or for 1 on the single-element path).

Appends the new node to the list: when a head exists at this+0x13C the tail's +0x24 next pointer becomes the new node; otherwise this+0x13C becomes the new node (and is cleared on allocation failure).
Copies the source data blocks from this+0x134 into the new node's block array, 136 bytes per block for the count at this+0x130, and stores the count into the node's block-count field.

For each copied block (stride 136), compares the block name at block+68 against parameter-table entries in a2 (entry count at a2+12, entries at a2+16, entry stride 44); on a match stores the table entry value from entry+32 into the block's first dword, otherwise writes -1.
Stores the parameter table pointer a2 into the new node at node+0x1C.
Calls EntityFlagSetSubInitChain on the new node to run the sub-init chain (flags, data copy, timer start).
